site.title: Paper Scanner — Pro Document Scanner for iOS & Android
site.description: A pro document scanner with ultra-wide capture, GPU-powered filters, OCR, multi-page PDF export, and Google Drive / iCloud sync.

hero.headline: Scan. Organize. Sync.
hero.sub: A pro document scanner with ultra-wide capture, six GPU-powered filters, OCR, multi-page PDF, and conflict-free sync to Google Drive & iCloud.

features.title: Built for serious document work
features.subtitle: Every feature is designed for real-world tasks — capturing, organising, and sharing paper without friction.

scanning.title: Ultra-wide capture
scanning.summary: Capture whole pages hands-free with the ultra-wide lens — fit A3 documents without stepping back.
scanning.body: Most phone cameras force you to stand up and walk backwards to fit a large page. The ultra-wide lens keeps the whole document in frame while you stay seated. Edge detection, perspective correction, and shadow removal all happen the moment you finish the shot, so you see a clean, flat page instantly.
useCases: Snap a full A3 handout on a meeting-room table without standing up
Capture an entire whiteboard in a single shot instead of stitching
Scan restaurant menus, instruction booklets, or magazine spreads
Take a multi-page document apart from the bound edition — page by page

filters.title: Six GPU filters
filters.summary: Pick from six hand-tuned filters that render instantly on your device — no cloud round-trip, no waiting.
filters.body: Filters run on the device GPU, so the preview is instant. Choose the look that fits the document: clean black & white for printed text, magic color for faded receipts, photo mode for preserves, and more. Adjust brightness, contrast, and shadow after the fact — every change stays on-device.
useCases: Black & white for contracts and printed forms
Magic color for restoring faded receipts and old book pages
Photo mode when you want to keep the original look
Quick brightness/contrast tweak when lighting was uneven

documents.title: Documents that stay organised
documents.summary: Folders, tags, grid or list view, batch operations, drag-and-drop, and full-text search.
documents.body: Every document lives in a local library. Build folder structures, tag documents, switch between grid and list views, multi-select for batch operations, merge related pages, and search the full text inside everything. All of it is local and instant — no syncing delay.
useCases: Set up a folder per client or project and tag by status (open / sent / paid)
Search across all your receipts by typing a vendor or amount
Merge a 20-page scan batch into one document with two taps
Use grid view for browsing, list view for dense libraries

ocr.title: On-device OCR
ocr.summary: Make scanned text selectable and searchable. Free tier covers daily use; Pro unlocks unlimited OCR.
ocr.body: OCR runs entirely on-device using Apple's and Google's machine learning kits. Select text inside a scan, copy it to another app, or let the search bar index every page in your library. The free tier includes a generous daily allowance; Pro removes the cap for users who scan hundreds of pages a week.
useCases: Copy a phone number or address off a scanned business card
Search a year's worth of receipts for one vendor
Quote a passage from a scanned book without retyping
Bulk-OCR an inbox of paper to make it searchable
ocr.proHint: Pro removes the daily OCR cap and processes your entire library in one go.

pdf.title: Multi-page PDF export
pdf.summary: Merge scans into a single PDF, password-protect it, print or share in one tap.
pdf.body: Take 50 pages from a meeting, merge them into a single PDF, add a password, and share it through any app on your phone. Print directly, send via email, or drop it into Drive. The export pipeline handles large batches and produces clean, compact files.
useCases: Email a 30-page contract to a client in a single attachment
Send a password-protected PDF of sensitive documents
Print a multi-page report straight from your phone
Export an entire folder as one PDF for archival

cloud.title: Conflict-free cloud sync
cloud.summary: Optional sync to your own Google Drive or iCloud. Nothing passes through our servers.
cloud.body: Cloud sync is a Pro-only feature. When you turn it on, your library is mirrored to your own Google Drive or iCloud — not to our infrastructure. New scans upload automatically. Downloads only run when you explicitly restore, so a sync never overwrites a local edit by accident. Cancel anytime; your data stays where you put it.
useCases: Switch phones and pick up exactly where you left off
Keep a backup in case the device is lost or damaged
Share your library with a partner or family member using shared Drive
Restore on a new device after wiping the old one
cloud.proHint: Pro unlocks cloud sync — the free tier stays local only.

pro.title: Paper Scanner Pro
pro.summary: Three upgrades for power users: unlimited OCR, ad-free, and automatic cloud sync.
pro.body: Pro is a single subscription that unlocks three improvements designed for heavy users. The free tier is fully usable for most people; Pro removes the limits and the ads. Subscriptions are managed by your app store — cancel anytime, no questions asked.
useCases: Scan hundreds of pages a week without hitting a daily OCR cap
Use the app for work without the documents banner above your library
Forget about manually pushing scans to the cloud — it just happens
Support continued development of the app

intro.title: A scanner that fits in your pocket
intro.body: Paper Scanner turns your phone into a professional document scanner. Capture entire pages with the ultra-wide lens, clean them up with GPU filters, find any text with on-device OCR, and sync the library to your own cloud — all without sending a single document through anyone else's server.

items.title: At the office
items.body: Sign a contract on paper, scan it, email the PDF — done before the meeting ends.

items.title: On the road
items.body: Snap a receipt the moment you get it. No more shoeboxes of paper at tax time.

items.title: In the classroom
items.body: Capture every handout and whiteboard before you leave the room. Search them later by keyword.

items.title: At home
items.body: Keep warranties, manuals, and IDs one tap away. Share them when a service agent asks.

about.title: About Paper Scanner
about.intro: Paper Scanner is built by a small team that got tired of juggling paper, photos, and clunky scanner apps. We believe scanning a document should be as quick as taking a photo — and your documents should stay yours.

principles.title: What we believe
items: Your documents are yours. They never touch our servers.
Scanning should be fast enough that you do it the moment you need to, not later when the paper is lost.
Free should be genuinely useful. Pro is for power users, not for unlocking basics.
